findings.summary: Lauder originated Trump's Greenland purchase idea per John Bolton; now investing in Greenland through Greenland Development Partners LLC (Delaware), buying stakes in Greenland Water Bank and Greenland Investment Group
findings.detail: Ronald Lauder, billionaire Estee Lauder heir and Trump's college friend from Wharton, first planted the idea of buying Greenland in Trump's mind according to former NSA John Bolton. Lauder has quietly taken ownership stakes in Greenlandic companies through Greenland Development Partners LLC, a Delaware-registered consortium that bought into at least two companies: Greenland Water Bank (Imivik spring water brand on Disko Island) and Greenland Investment Group (broader energy/infrastructure ambitions). The consortium is chaired by Josette Sheeran, former Under Secretary of State under Condoleezza Rice and former UN WFP head. Lauder's local partners include Jorgen Waever Johansen (husband of Greenland's foreign minister Vivian Motzfeldt, chairs governing Siumut party in Nuuk) and Svend Hardenberg (former top civil servant and energy executive). Lauder wrote in the New York Post that Trump's Greenland concept was 'never absurd - it was strategic' and called it 'America's next frontier.'

findings.summary: Lauder published Feb 2025 NYPost op-ed defending Trump Greenland concept as strategic, revealing he has worked closely with Greenland business and government leaders for years. EDGAR: Central European Media Enterprises board.
findings.detail: In February 2025, Ronald Lauder published a New York Post op-ed titled 'I'm a Greenland expert -- these 3 paths can make it America's next frontier.' He wrote: 'Trump's Greenland concept was never absurd -- it was strategic' and 'I have worked closely with Greenland's business and government leaders for years to develop strategic investments there, even as the Biden administration, unsurprisingly, ignored and underestimated its vast opportunity.' This is significant: Lauder publicly admits years of relationship-building with Greenland officials while simultaneously profiting from investments there and influencing Trump's policy. EDGAR shows Lauder was on the board of Central European Media Enterprises Ltd (CIK 0000925645) -- power of attorney 2005, 8-K filings 2001-2012. LittleSis ID: 5617. Blurb: MoMA trustee, former Deputy Assistant Secretary of Defense for European and NATO policy, Netanyahu supporter. Lead: 21192.
